title: Mothers 80Th Birthday

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S.I., Special Branch Report
Date January 11th 1933.
Subject (in full) Dinner Party held on the occasion of Dr. C.T. Wang's
mother's 80th Birthday.
Made by D.S.I. Duncan Forwarded by [Signature] Supt.
The dinner party and reception held in the
Great Eastern Hotel on the occasion of Dr. C.T. Wang's
mother's 80th birthday commenced at 7 p.m. January 10
and terminated at 12.45 a.m. January 11. No
untoward incident occurred.
The following officers attached to the
Special Branch were on duty inside the hotel between
6.40 p.m. and 1 a.m.

Special Branch,
January 10, 1933.

On the occasion of Dr. C.T.Wang's mother's
80th birthday, Dr. and Madame Wang are giving
a dinner party on January 10 at 7 p.m. in the
Great Eastern Hotel (Wing On) to various
diplomatic representatives in Shanghai and their
wives and also important members of the Government.

The following officers of the Special
Branch are detailed for duty inside the hotel from
6.40 p.m. onward under D.S.I. Duncan who will
confer with C.I. i/c Lousa with a view to
cooperating with officers detailed from that
Station for traffic and protection duties.

特别处，
1933年1月10日。

值此王正廷博士令堂八十寿辰之际，王博士夫妇定于1月10日晚7时在汇中饭店（永安）举办晚宴，宴请驻沪各国外交代表及其夫人，以及政府重要成员。

下列特别处警官自下午6时40分起在饭店内执勤，由副督察长邓肯（Duncan）负责指挥。邓肯将与老闸捕房主管首席督察员会商，以便与该捕房指派负责交通及警卫任务的警官进行合作。

page_data.en:
1572 Sinza Road
Shanghai,
January.

A.D.Bell, Esq.,
Chairman,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Dear Mr. Bell,

Tomorrow, January 10th, is the
occasion of Dr. C.T.Wang's mother's 80th birthday.
Dr. and Madame Wang are giving a dinner party
tomorrow evening at 7.00 o'clock at the Great
Eastern Hotel, Nanking Road, to various diplomatic
representatives in Shanghai and their wives, and
also various important members of the Government,
to which your good self and Mrs. Bell have also
been cordially invited.

I have been asked by Dr. Wang, who
is member of the State Council of the Government,
to request your favour as to instruct your Police
Department to be aware of the afore-mentioned
occasion, and to arrange for some police and
detectives sent to the vicinity of the Great
Eastern Hotel. Dr. Wang wishes to thank you
in anticipation for this courtesy, and I shall
be glad to get into touch with any representative
of your Police Department at any time during
tomorrow.

With best wishes and regards,
Yours faithfully,
(Sd.) Y.F.Lieu.
page_data.zh:
上海新闸路1572号
1月。

致 A.D.贝尔 先生，
主席，
上海公共租界工部局。

尊敬的贝尔先生：

明日，1月10日，正值王正廷博士令堂八十寿辰。王博士夫妇将于明晚7时在南京路汇中饭店举办晚宴，宴请驻沪各国外交代表及其夫人，以及政府各位要员。您和贝尔夫人亦蒙盛情邀请。

王博士身为国民政府国务会议成员，嘱我恳请阁下惠予关照，指示贵局警务处知悉上述活动，并安排若干巡捕及侦探前往汇中饭店附近值守。王博士谨此预先致谢，感激阁下的礼遇。如有需要，我随时乐意于明日与贵警务处的任何代表取得联系。

顺颂
时祺

您忠实的，
（签名）刘馥（Y.F.Lieu）
